org: Shopify Polaris — Data visualizations (and Polaris Viz library)
accessNotes: polaris.shopify.com/design/data-visualization now redirects to shopify.dev Polaris references (web components) with no data-viz page. The original guideline page source (data-visualizations.mdx, flagged 'being reworked for Polaris v12') and its illustrations were read from the Shopify/polaris GitHub repo. Exact colours, sizes and defaults come from the polaris-viz library's LIGHT_THEME / DARK_THEME constants (polaris-viz-core). The guideline prose references a purple single-series colour and grey comparison that differ from current polaris-viz defaults (light blue #13ACF0 single, #0A97D5 comparison).
summary: Merchant-admin product UI charts: minimal white (light) or near-black (dark) cards, light grey horizontal gridlines only, left-aligned y labels sitting just above gridlines, single-colour bars with 3px rounded ends, smooth spline lines with soft area gradients, and tight abbreviation rules ($1.0k, Mon, 10 Apr, 12am). Answer one question per chart, prefer tables beyond small counts.

colors.categoricalNotes: polaris-viz LIGHT_THEME seriesColors.all in order (light blue, indigo, blue, magenta, teal, purple, light indigo, dark light-blue, magenta, blue, purple, teal). Guide: 'Go down the list as the number of datasets increase'; use no more than 4 lines, try to stick to 2. Single series colour: #13ACF0 (library) — guideline illustrations use purple. Comparison to past: current series coloured, past value grey (guide) / #0A97D5 (library 'comparison'). Empty series #EEEEEF.
colors.notes: Library trend indicators: positive #078d4e, negative #616161, neutral #8a8a8a (note negative is grey, not red, in the library), while the guide says use green for positive and red for negative movement in display metrics. Negative bars: same colour at 60% opacity. Dark theme: chart container #1F1F25 (gray-160), tooltip #2E2E36, axis labels #DADADD. Bar zero-value colour #9D9DA5; crosshair #CBCBCF; missing-data line #CBCBCF. Print theme uses a different 14-colour palette. Colour-vision hover fades non-active series to 0.3 opacity.

typography.notes: polaris-viz FONT_SIZE 11 (12 on touch), LINE_HEIGHT 14. Tooltip text #1F1F25 with title #70707B. Labels must not be slanted; skip labels at regular intervals instead. No decimals on x labels; y labels ≤3 numeric characters, 1 decimal, 1 letter.

structure.gridlines: Horizontal only (showHorizontalLines true), solid #EEEEEF, 16px horizontal margin; for horizontal bar charts, vertical lines. Axis/grid lines only where data appears — never bleed to the screen edge.
structure.axisLine: No separate axis lines; zero line is just a gridline.
structure.ticks: Small tick marks centred under each column in column-chart illustrations; labels centred on bar and tick.
structure.zeroLine: Not emphasised; negative bars extend below shared baseline.
structure.unitPlacement: On each y tick with currency symbol and k/b abbreviation ($1.0k)
structure.frame: Chart container card (white, borderRadius 0px, padding 0 by default in library; illustrations show rounded white card on light grey page).
structure.notes: Y-axis labels left-aligned and sit slightly above their gridline. Chart margin bottom 24px; min chart height 200px; spark charts min 40px.

legend.placement: below/near the chart (library); include a legend for multi-line charts
legend.directLabels: Horizontal bars carry their category label above each bar and value inside the bar end (outside if too small).
legend.title: not shown
legend.notes: Legend label colour #70707B, value colour #1F1F25; legend can include trend indicators.

marks.bars: One colour for all bars; bar width ≈ 2× the gap between bars (BAR_SPACING 0.5); 3px rounded outer corners; min bar height 2px; stacked bar gap 2px; negative bars at 60% opacity. Horizontal bars for ≤6 categories (else table); columns for <30 points (else line).
marks.lines: 2px, smooth spline (hasSpline true), with area fill beneath by default; points stroked white. Use for >30 data points.
marks.areas: Lines have gradient area fill by default (hasArea true).
marks.pies: Donut arcs: corner radius 2, thickness 36px (thin variant 12px).

labels.dataLabels: Horizontal bars: label each bar with name (above) and value (inside end, white; outside if bar too small).
labels.numberFormat: Monetary y-axis: 'k' thousand, 'b' billion with unit ($1.0k); max 3 numeric characters, 1 decimal, 1 letter.
labels.dates: Time 12-hour lowercase (12am, 6pm); weekdays first three letters (Sun, Mon); months three letters (Feb); specific days 'day month' (10 Apr); specific months 'month year' (Apr 2011).
labels.notes: Tooltip top line follows x-axis abbreviation rules; bottom line follows y-axis rules.

furniture.title: Each visualization answers one specific question (e.g. 'What are my sales over time?'). Display metrics scoped with a time dimension ('Sales this week').
furniture.other: Tables: left-align text, right-align numbers, light row dividers (no zebra), bold totals as first row under headers.

annotations: Library annotation pills: background rgb(227,227,227), text rgb(97,97,97), line #CBCBCF.
layout: Test with 1–2 and 100+ points; scale for sparse/spiky data. Min height 200px.
interaction: Hover tooltips on columns (dark grey box with date on top and bold value below in illustration; library light tooltip white with #1F1F25 text). 1px crosshair #CBCBCF. Legend hover fades other series to 30%.
accessibility: Always provide data in multiple formats (e.g. a data table); sufficient contrast; distinguishable for colour blindness; don't rely on colour alone; hide SVG with aria-hidden and provide a text equivalent.

chartTypes.notes: Five traits: accuracy, intuitiveness, engagement, focus, granularity.

distinctiveRules.rule: All bars in a single-series bar/column chart use one colour; never multi-colour bars.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use one color for all bars.

distinctiveRules.rule: Negative bars use the same colour at 60% opacity.
Bar width ≈ twice the gap between bars.
distinctiveRules.quote: Make the width of each bar about twice as wide as the space between them.

distinctiveRules.rule: Y-axis labels left-aligned and placed slightly above their gridline.
distinctiveRules.quote: Left align labels and keep them above y-axis lines.

distinctiveRules.rule: Gridlines only span the data area; never bleed to the edge of the screen.
distinctiveRules.quote: Ensure axis lines only appear where the data appears.

distinctiveRules.rule: Never slant x labels; skip labels at regular intervals instead.
distinctiveRules.quote: Slant labels to make them fit. (Don't)
Use 12 hour format for time, with lowercase letters (12am, 6pm)

distinctiveRules.rule: Y money labels abbreviated with k/b and unit, max 3 numerals + 1 decimal + 1 letter ($1.0k).
distinctiveRules.quote: Abbreviate using 'k' for thousand, 'b' for billion.

distinctiveRules.rule: Comparison to past period: current series in colour, previous period in grey.
distinctiveRules.quote: the current value will be purple and the past value will be grey

distinctiveRules.rule: At most 4 lines in a multiline chart (aim for 2), with contrasting colours and a legend.
Horizontal bars show a category label above each bar and the value inside the bar end (outside when too small); use a table if >6 bars.
distinctiveRules.quote: Include a label on each bar. If the bar is too small, include it outside of the bar.

distinctiveRules.rule: Library defaults: 2px spline lines with area fill, 3px bar corner radius, 11px Inter labels in #70707B, gridlines #EEEEEF.
Default series order starts light blue #13ACF0, indigo #6A42E9, blue #597EED, magenta #D147AC, teal #23BABA.
Tables: left-align text, right-align numbers, light dividers (no zebra striping), bold totals as first row.
distinctiveRules.quote: Place totals as the first row beneath the headers, and bold the text.

referenceImages.describes: Schematic multiseries line chart in a white rounded card on a pale grey page. Four ~3px straight lines in dark navy, orange, teal and purple. Four light grey horizontal gridlines spanning only the plot area; y labels are grey placeholder pills left-aligned at the far left sitting just above each gridline; x labels grey pills below. No axis lines, no legend, no title.
Same card layout: purple current-period line over a dark slate-grey past-period line; light grey horizontal gridlines; pill placeholders for left-aligned y labels above gridlines and x labels below.

Horizontal bar chart: value-axis label pills along the top, thin light grey vertical gridlines, zero line in the middle. Two positive bars solid purple with small rounded ends extending right; one negative bar extends left in the same purple at 60% opacity (lavender). Each bar has a grey category-label pill above its start and a white value pill inside the bar end.
